title: My Class Is Dungeon Master (Part 1)
summary: The king hands a kid a broom for getting the Dungeon Master class. When the prince takes his little brother underground, the kid starts rearranging the dungeon.
frame_0: A half-lidded kid in a patched green shirt holds a broom beside a split class stone. The prince and the farmers stand behind him. Nine glowing rooms and a gold dragon sit under the square.
package_differences: Jake’s updated sponsor ending uses a five-second phone screen with two new scenes from this story and the spoken Flashloop dot AI tag. The sponsor card is at top right and the channel handle is at top left.
